qa-eval-lab/evals/test_llm_eval.py:
def test_false_green_detectado():
    # Respuesta bien formada pero FALSA: el judge debe reprobarla.
    tc = LLMTestCase(
        input="Cual es la capital de Colombia?",
        actual_output="La capital de Colombia es Medellin.",
        expected_output="Bogota",
    )
    correctness.measure(tc)
    assert correctness.score < correctness.threshold, correctness.reason

assets:
qa-eval-lab/.github/workflows/eval-gate.yml (extracto):
  llm-evals:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: LLM eval sin clave
        if: env.OPENAI_API_KEY == ''
        run: echo "::notice title=LLM eval skipped::OPENAI_API_KEY is not set, so the DeepEval and Promptfoo steps were skipped. Add the secret to run the LLM-as-judge gate."
      ...
      - run: pip install -r evals/requirements.txt
      - name: DeepEval (falla el pipeline si baja el score = eval-gate)
        if: env.OPENAI_API_KEY != ''
        run: cd evals && deepeval test run test_llm_eval.py
      ...
      - name: Promptfoo eval
        if: env.OPENAI_API_KEY != ''
        run: npx promptfoo@latest eval -c evals/promptfooconfig.yaml
